statement: Let A satisfy (B.3) on a smooth m-manifold, m ≥ 2, with smooth positive ω and smooth p. Put S = supp |DχA|. Then S = Sreg ∪ Σ, where Sreg is a smooth embedded hypersurface, Σ is relatively closed, and dimH Σ ≤ m − 8. (B.8) 59 A negative dimension bound means that Σ is empty. The outward measure-theoretic normal extends smoothly on Sreg. With B(u, v) = ⟨∇uν, v⟩, its base mean curvature satisfies Hg = p − ∂ν log ω. (B.9) The unweighted multiplicity-one perimeter varifold has locally bounded generalized mean curvature. Its density exists at every support point; monotonicity gives local uniform area upper bounds and positive area lower bounds at support points. Under the convergences of Theorem B.3, densities are upper semicontinuous at converging points, provided the local generalized-mean-curvature bounds are uniform. The supports converge locally, and on every compact subset of the regular limiting hypersurface convergence is smooth and single-sheeted when the data converge smoothly. On compact subsets of the interiors of the limiting phases there is eventually no boundary. Every tangent at a point of S is a multiplicity-one locally perimeter-minimizing boundary cone in the Euclidean tangent space. A flat tangent implies regularity. A tangent at a singular point is therefore nonflat, and its translation-invariance spine has dimension at most m − 8.
